items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses a club (Anise/Club) and mentions Ray Nance worked there in 1939, but does not describe a personal interaction or professional relationship with Nance himself.

ctx.x: I think so. But he's one of the old-guard cats, you know. I can't think of his name now. I just happened to think of the name of that club, the Anise(?) Club, right off 22nd on Street Club. We'd go to the Anise(?) Club. We'd go to the...was it the Cotton Club? It was a club where they had all faggots dancing. I remember that. [PERHAPS JOE HUGHES' CLUB, WHERE RAY NANCE WORKED IN 1939, AFTER LEAVING HORACE HENDERSON]
Where Jimmie Noone worked [EL RADO CAFE]?
